pattern.description: Screen recording: the cursor clicks the Delivery tab in the idea sidebar; the Overview content is swapped instantly for the delivery panel while the tab selection state transfers with a brief fade on the old tab.
pattern.why_premium: Real product interaction shown at a readable crop with the cursor landing exactly as the narration moves to delivery, so the viewer follows cause and effect without extra graphics.

build_hint.gsap: Cursor move to tab, then tl.set(overviewPanel,{autoAlpha:0}).set(deliveryPanel,{autoAlpha:1}) at click; tl.to(overviewTab,{backgroundColor:'transparent',color:'#44546f',duration:0.35,ease:'power2.out'},'<').set(deliveryTab,{backgroundColor:'#1d2a4a',color:'#fff'},'<').fromTo(focusRing,{opacity:0},{opacity:1,duration:0.1},'<')
build_hint.remotion: At click frame, switch rendered panel (conditional render, no tween); overview tab background via interpolate(frame,[click,click+10],[1,0],{extrapolateRight:'clamp',easing:Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); delivery tab selected state set on click frame.

notes: Screen recording of a real UI tab switch; content swap is effectively a hard swap within one frame. b04's removed text is a best guess at which Overview line sat in that band (filmstrip frames are cropped differently). No SFX candidates.
